summary: Li Bang International Corp Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to $60 million in Class A ordinary shares through agent AC Sunshine Securities LLC, with $9.3 million already sold. The shares trade on Nasdaq under LBGJ at $1.26 per share on July 6, 2026. The agent receives 3.5% commission. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation. No change of control, restructuring, or strategic event is present.
